Even when the surgery is extremely busy, Jacqui somehow manages to make you feel heard, valued, and supported.

I’m going through a very difficult period right now, and her empathy has meant more than she could ever know. She has taken the time to listen, to help, and to reassure me when I’ve felt overwhelmed or uncertain. Those small moments of humanity make an enormous difference.
